pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + one saddle. The exact saddle becomes its first equipment. Creative defaults start unequipped.
Starts waiting. Only the owner may equip and ride it. Its three slots hold a saddle, elytra, and Slime Armor; it has no cargo bag. Apply gear by right-clicking an empty slot or use the tuner.
Right-click a saddled companion to ride. Shift dismounts; Shift-right-click recovers it. Visible saddles and wings show equipped gear. See $(l:care/flight)Mounted flight$() for steering and stamina.
